conclusions: A shared model-induction cohort is compatible with separate model and restoration terminal groups. It is not evidence of paired terminal RVLM measurements.

A rat sampled terminally for medullary tissue at week 4 cannot later supply another terminal tissue specimen at week 8. If the author means the same nominal 10 animals, the source of the week-4 model tissue must be clarified before any statistical or factual change.
Do not change n, randomization, terminal sampling dates, numerical values or the independent-group analysis while the clarification is pending.
Repeated blood-pressure readings could be longitudinal within surviving restoration animals if individual records establish identity, but that would not make destructive tissue endpoints paired.

Original qPCR exports and curve recovery removes the blanket claim that all instrument outputs/curves are unavailable, but does not validate efficiency, reference stability, control performance, well mapping or ethics chronology.

items.current_text: The Animal Ethics Committee of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine approved the 60-rat parent experiment, model induction, implant removal and terminal sampling (AHUCM-rats-2022032). Clean-grade male Wistar rats (approximately 12 weeks, 250 g; Anhui Medical University, license SCXK [Wan] 2017-001) were individually housed at 22 ± 1°C and 60% humidity under 12 h light/dark cycles, with free food/water and 1-week acclimatization. Animals were randomized to sham operation (10) or model induction (50). Six rats died intraoperatively and three afterward; seven survivors lost implants, leaving 34 with retained implants. Successfully modeled rats were randomized to model, restoration or superior cervical ganglion resection groups (10 each); four remained in reserve. This report includes sham, model and restoration cohorts only, initially 10 per group; each biochemical endpoint and RT-qPCR used six randomly selected independent rats per group without pooling. No single primary endpoint or formal a priori power calculation was specified. Animal-to-sample identifiers and cross-assay overlap could not be recovered.
items.recommended_action: The existing text already describes a common model-induction source cohort followed by allocation to separate terminal groups. Add one clarification only if the pending author reply confirms this meaning.
items.proposed_text_for_internal_review: Restoration rats originated from the same successfully modeled cohort and were continued after implant removal at week 4 until terminal sampling at week 8; they were not the model rats sampled terminally at week 4.

items.current_text: The parent experiment numbered 60 rats and allocated them by random numbers to sham operation (10) or model induction (50). All sham rats survived. During model induction, 6 rats died during surgery and 3 afterward; 41 survived, including 7 with implant loss and 34 with retained implants. After imaging and blood-pressure screening at week 4, successfully modeled rats were assigned by random numbers to model, restoration, and superior cervical ganglion resection groups of 10. The remaining 4 rats with retained implants were kept in reserve and were not allocated to the three subsequent 10-rat groups. This report includes only sham, model, and restoration rats, initially 10 per group; ganglion-resection and electrophysiological results are not presented.
items.recommended_action: Retain 60 -> 10 sham + 50 model induction -> 34 retained implant -> 10 model + 10 restoration + 10 SCG + 4 reserve. If confirmed, add the same clarification that separate terminal groups originated from a common modeled cohort.

items.current_text: Sham/model rats were sampled at week 4 and restoration rats at week 8, without a time-matched second-surgery sham control. Abdominal aortic sampling under isoflurane was followed by inhaled-isoflurane overdose; death was confirmed when spontaneous breathing, palpable cardiac activity and withdrawal to a noxious stimulus were all absent, before brainstem removal. Atlas-guided bilateral tissue blocks (approximately 100 mg/rat) contained RVLM and adjacent medulla. For biochemical assays, tissue was lysed in RIPA/PMSF and protein measured by BCA. SOD (A001-3, WST-1) and MDA (A003-1, thiobarbituric acid; Nanjing Jiancheng) used RT-6000 absorbance readings at 450 and 530 nm, respectively; the MDA manual specified 532 nm. The fluorescence-reader model was not retained. BestBio BB-475015 O12 fluorescence was measured at excitation/emission 488/530 nm and divided by protein concentration, yielding an arbitrary-unit (AU) index. This serum-designated assay lacked tissue-matrix and buffer-compatibility validation; fluorescence is not an absolute ROS concentration or species-specific measure.
items.recommended_action: Retain week-4 versus week-8 sampling and absence of a time-matched second-surgery sham control. Shared model origin does not remove time confounding.

items.current_text: 伪手术及模型组第4周取材，复位组第8周取材，未设置时间匹配的二次手术假手术对照。异氟烷麻醉下腹主动脉采样后，以过量吸入异氟烷安乐死；确认自主呼吸、可触及心搏及伤害性回缩反射均消失后分离脑干。参照图谱取双侧区域组织块，每只约100 mg，含RVLM及邻近延髓。生化检测采用RIPA/PMSF裂解，BCA测蛋白。SOD（A001-3，WST-1法）和MDA（A003-1，硫代巴比妥酸法，南京建成）采用RT-6000读取450和530 nm吸光度；MDA说明书规定532 nm。荧光读数仪型号未留存。BestBio BB-475015 O12荧光激发/发射波长为488/530 nm，以蛋白浓度归一化，报告任意单位（AU）指数。该血清用途检测未验证组织基质及裂解液兼容性；荧光不代表绝对ROS浓度或特定ROS种类。

items.current_text: The implant was removed from restoration rats at week 4. Terminal sampling was at week 4 for sham and model rats and week 8 for restoration rats, without a time-matched second-surgery sham group. Each biochemical endpoint and RT-qPCR included 6 randomly selected independent rats per group, processed separately without cross-animal pooling. Target and reference Cq values were paired within each rat and measured once each. Original animal identifiers could not be matched to assay samples; numerical record order cannot establish pairing across assays or fully reconstruct premeasurement exclusions. The parent design allowed for preliminary estimates of 18% mortality and 17% implant loss to obtain at least 30 modeled rats. No single primary endpoint or formal outcome-based a priori sample-size calculation was specified.
items.recommended_action: Retain independent terminal specimens and within-rat target/reference Cq pairing. Add an explicit distinction if needed: target/reference pairing is within one terminal sample and is not longitudinal pairing between model/restoration groups.

items.current_text: RNA extraction used TRIzol; reverse transcription used PrimeScript RR047A, followed by SYBR RT-qPCR on PikoReal 96. Each target and paired β-actin reference was measured once per rat, without technical replication. Within-rat ΔCq was target minus reference Cq. Relative quantity was calculated as  and divided by the arithmetic mean quantity of the six sham rats [7]. This assumes equal, approximately 100% amplification efficiencies. Efficiencies and β-actin stability were not validated; original amplification/melting curves and no-template/no-reverse-transcription control records were unavailable. Reagent details, primers, protocols and source-flow information are retained in Supplementary Methods.

items.current_text: Reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) analyses included 6 independent rats per group (n = 6). Each target and reference quantification cycle (Cq) was measured once per rat. Target and reference Cq values in the same worksheet column corresponded to the same animal and were paired within that animal. Samples were not pooled. Total RNA was extracted from medullary tissue blocks containing the RVLM using TRIzol reagent (Life Technologies; Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc.; cat. no. 15596018). Genomic DNA was removed from 1 µg of RNA in a 10 µl reaction at 42°C for 2 min, followed by 1 min on ice. Reverse transcription was performed using PrimeScript RT reagent Kit with gDNA Eraser (Takara Bio, Inc.; cat. no. RR047A) in a 20 µl reaction at 37°C for 15 min followed by 85°C for 5 s. RT-qPCR used NovoStart SYBR qPCR SuperMix Plus (Novoprotein; cat. no. E096-01B) and a PikoReal 96 real-time PCR system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc.). Each 10 µl reaction contained 5 µl of 2× SYBR mix, 1 µl each of forward and reverse primers (10 µmol/l), 1 µl of cDNA, and 2 µl of RNase-free water. Primer sequences were as follows: Nox1 forward, 5'-GCTCCAGACCTCCATTTG-3'; Nox1 reverse, 5'-CAGCCCCAACCAAGAAAC-3'; Nox4 forward, 5'-GGGTTAAACACCTCTGTC-3'; Nox4 reverse, 5'-GTAGTATTCTGGCCCTTG-3'; β-actin forward, 5'-CCCATCTATGAGGGTTACGC-3'; and β-actin reverse, 5'-TTTAATGTCACGCACGATTTC-3'. Expected amplicon lengths for Nox1, Nox4, and β-actin were 84, 95, and 150 bp, respectively. Cycling conditions were 95°C for 1 min followed by 40 cycles of 95°C for 20 s and 60°C for 1 min. Conversion to relative quantities assumed equal amplification efficiencies of approximately 100% for each target and β-actin [7]. Within-animal ΔCq was defined as target Cq minus the paired β-actin Cq. Relative quantity was calculated as . For each gene, this quantity was divided by the arithmetic mean of the relative quantities from the 6 sham-operated rats, giving the sham-operated group an arithmetic mean of 1. Amplification efficiencies and reference-gene stability were not validated. The assay reports mentioned amplification and melting-curve results, but the original curves were unavailable for inspection. Records of no-template controls (NTC) and no-reverse-transcription controls (no-RT) were also unavailable.
items.recommended_action: Replace the final sentences saying original curves are unavailable. Do not alter numerical Cq values, classifications of Empty wells, or dates before reconciliation.

items.current_text: We examined regional medullary redox indices and Nox1/Nox4 transcripts in male Wistar rats with atlantoaxial joint disorder. Sham-operated and model rats were sampled at week 4; restoration rats underwent implant removal at week 4 and sampling at week 8. Each endpoint included six independent rats per group. In tissue containing the rostral ventrolateral medulla (RVLM) and adjacent medulla, week-4 model rats had lower SOD activity, higher MDA and probe-associated fluorescence, and estimated Nox1/Nox4 expression of 1.46/2.90-fold relative to sham rats. Restoration values were generally closer to sham values at the later endpoint. Unmatched sampling times, absent second-surgery controls, unvalidated tissue fluorescence-assay applicability, incomplete qPCR quality-control records and omission of postoperative analgesia limit interpretation. These exploratory observations do not establish RVLM-specific changes, NOX-dependent sympathetic mediation or an implant-removal effect.
items.recommended_action: Incomplete qPCR quality control is not automatically obsolete merely because curves were recovered. Retain provisionally; narrow to the specific remaining limitations after well mapping, controls and dates are reconciled. Do not state all QC is complete.

items.current_text: Interpretation remains constrained by regional rather than RVLM-specific sampling, incomplete qPCR quality control and untraceable cross-assay identities. Later restoration observations confound implant removal with age, elapsed time, recovery and repeat anesthesia/surgery. Omission of postoperative analgesia raises animal-welfare concerns and possible pain/stress confounding. Small exploratory samples and male-only inclusion limit precision and generalizability. The same-day model–sham comparison supports a regional phenotype; validated assays, anatomical localization and time-matched controls are required to investigate NOX-dependent sympathetic mediation or an implant-removal effect.

items.current_text: 本研究检测寰枢关节紊乱雄性Wistar大鼠区域延髓组织的氧化还原指标及Nox1/Nox4转录本。伪手术及模型组于第4周取材；复位组第4周取出异物、第8周取材。各终点每组6只独立动物。在包含头端延髓腹外侧区（RVLM）及邻近延髓的组织中，第4周模型组较伪手术组SOD活性低，MDA及探针相关荧光高，Nox1/Nox4表达估计值分别为伪手术组的1.46/2.90倍。较晚终点的复位组数值总体更接近伪手术组。取材时间不匹配、缺少二次手术对照、组织荧光检测适用性未经验证、qPCR质控记录不完整及未使用术后镇痛限制了结果解释。上述探索性观察不能确立RVLM特异性变化、NOX依赖的交感神经介导作用或异物取出效应。

items.current_text: RT-qPCR inference used within-animal ΔCq values and independent-group Welch t tests. All 18 comparisons across the original six-target panel (AT1-R, Nox1, Nox4, RhoA, ROCK1, and ROCK2) formed one Holm correction family; correction was not restricted to the displayed genes. Supplementary Data 2, File 4, and Appendix 2 provide paired inputs, complete t statistics, degrees of freedom and exact P values, and reproducible code. Animal overlap across assays was not recoverable, so no cross-assay correlations were tested. Archived blood-pressure and H&E materials were displayed without new inferential tests. Model–sham comparisons use week-4 samples; comparisons involving restoration use week-8 samples.
items.recommended_action: Retain independent-group Welch t tests for terminal model/restoration tissue. Within-animal ΔCq pairs target and reference within the same specimen. Cross-group longitudinal pairing is unsupported.

items.current_text: Estimated Nox1 and Nox4 expression in restoration rats was 1.180 ± 0.090 and 1.645 ± 0.227, respectively (Fig. 2; n = 6). Both were lower than in model rats, with Holm-adjusted P values of 0.0139 and 0.0037. Compared with sham rats, estimated Nox4 expression was higher (P = 0.0099), whereas the Nox1 difference did not meet the adjusted significance threshold (P = 0.0618). Nonsignificant SOD and Nox1 differences do not establish equivalence or normalization. Comparisons involving restoration rats span different terminal sampling times and cannot isolate an implant-removal effect.
items.recommended_action: Retain different terminal sampling times and inability to isolate implant-removal effects. Shared modeled origin does not provide a week-8 untreated comparison.
